What this kit is

A complete job-search system for freshers, final-year students and career switchers who want to become data analysts. You get a plan to follow, projects to put on your resume, questions to practise and messages to send. Everything is built around Indian hiring: Naukri, LinkedIn referrals, D2C and quick-commerce examples, and HR questions like CTC and notice period.

Why this kit is different

Many bundles focus on interview questions and resume files. A fresher also needs projects to talk about, a clear plan and a way to reach recruiters. Here is where each need is covered in this kit.

The two portfolio projects

Project 1: Indian D2C e-commerce sales and retention

Analyse revenue, returns, cancellations and repeat customers for an online brand selling across Indian cities.

  • Practice dataset: 5,500 raw rows cleaned down to 5,429 orders
  • Jupyter notebook with cleaning and EDA, already run
  • 15 business SQL queries with CTEs and window functions
  • Executive sales dashboard in Excel and a walkthrough script

Project 2: Quick-commerce delivery operations

Study 10-minute delivery performance for dark stores, in the style of Blinkit and Zepto.

  • Practice dataset: 5,500 raw rows cleaned down to 5,412 orders
  • Jupyter notebook with cleaning and EDA, already run
  • 15 operations SQL queries
  • Operations KPI dashboard in Excel and a Power BI build guide with DAX
  • Walkthrough script for interviews

How to use it

  1. Days 1 to 4: polish your resumePick a template, rewrite bullets with the impact formulas and make it ATS-readable.
  2. Days 5 to 14: build the portfolioWork through both projects with SQL, Excel and Power BI, then publish them.
  3. Days 15 to 22: practise interviewsDrill the 125 questions and rehearse your two-minute pitch.
  4. Days 23 to 30: reach out and applyOptimise Naukri, message people on LinkedIn and track every application.

The 30-day plan asks for about 2 hours a day. In a hurry? The roadmap also has a 14-day fast track.

A sample from the kit

Every SQL question comes with the input table, expected output, a tested solution and advice on what to say and what not to say. Here is the first one:

Q01: Find employees who earn more than their managers (self-join)

SELECT e.name AS employee_name,
       e.salary AS employee_salary
FROM employees e
JOIN employees m
  ON e.manager_id = m.id
WHERE e.salary > m.salary;

Frequently asked questions

What do I get after paying?

You get a download with 39 files: PDFs, Word resume templates, Excel workbooks, Jupyter notebooks, SQL files, CSV datasets and an interactive HTML hub. On mobile, the download opens from checkout after you enter your UTR. On desktop, we email the download link after reviewing the payment details.

Do I need coding experience?

No advanced experience. The kit teaches by practice with SQL, Excel, Python Pandas and Power BI, but some basic familiarity with these tools helps you move faster.

Which software do I need?

Microsoft Excel or a compatible spreadsheet app, a PDF reader and a browser. To run the notebooks you need Python with Jupyter. The Power BI guide needs Power BI Desktop.

Are the resume templates ATS-friendly?

Yes. They are single-column Word files with no text boxes, so applicant tracking systems can read them easily.

Is there a video course?

No. The kit is made of documents, templates, projects and practice material that you read and work through at your own pace.

Does it include HR email lists or job openings?

No. It teaches you how to find and message recruiters and gives you templates and a tracker, but it does not include contact lists or job listings.

Will this get me a job?

No kit can promise that. This one gives you a clear plan, a stronger resume, portfolio projects and interview practice. Your results depend on your effort and the market.

Can I put the projects on my resume?

Yes. The kit shows you how to write resume bullets and explain each project in an interview. The datasets are practice datasets, so say that honestly and present your own findings in your own words.

How does payment work?

Tap Get the kit. On a phone, pay in your UPI app, return to checkout, and enter your 12-digit UTR to open the download. On a computer, scan the QR code with your phone and send your payment details for email delivery.

Is it a one-time payment?

Yes. You pay once and there is no subscription.
